moni.quest.0E9B96B17D140B99.description1: Also known as PEEK, this plastic will be used for coating cables of &4UHV&r+ voltage and as an incredibly fast item pipe.
moni.quest.1C861E0C62D5B97D.description2: (Unique multi mechanic code taken from the Cosmic Frontiers team with Caitlynn's gracious permission.)
moni.quest.1E36AFB19932C805.description2: If you haven't made it already, you will need &6Polyethyl Cyanoacrylate&r.
moni.quest.3B3F46345D39CAE2.description3: The dusts need to be &2bathed in Hydrochloric Acid to make Tungstic Acid, then electrolyzed&r to get to the Tungsten, which then needs to be cooked in the EBF for Tungsten Ingots.
moni.quest.476F71CC0B0AC2A4.description2: Fluorine is best obtained from Topaz or Bastnasite Ore processing from their Microminer missions, and from processing renewable &9Deepslate.
moni.quest.4C0BCA64D5B409F2.description2: With this you can make &aUEV &6Energy Hatches&r, unlocking the &3Dimensonal Superassembler&r, &3Transdimensional Energy Singularity&r, and the most efficient recipe for &6Optical Circuits&r using &6Photonic SoCs&r.
moni.quest.5911900438648430.description1: As the most advanced polymer you will need to make, &6Polyethyl Cyanoacrylate&r is required for a few endgame crafts.
moni.quest.5FB696EF1D2412F5.description1: &9Deepslate Processing is a great way to get tons of Fluorine and Thorium. Therefore, it is recommended to setup this process as soon as possible.&r
moni.quest.634E056463ED1532.description2: This alloy is cooked in an &3Electric Blast Furnace&r and cooled in a &3Vacuum Freezer&r.
moni.quest.6BE1CD77618EC6C7.description1: &2Thin Polyphenylene Sulfide Sheets are required for wrapping LuV+ cables.
moni.quest.6DC635766CD40FFF.description2: With these coils, you can now smelt &6Tantalum Carbide&r, required for the &3Alloy Blast Smelter&r.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.description1: &n&9Monifactory&r&r shares an official Discord server with Pansmith's various projects, which serves as a useful community resource.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.description2: On the server, there are flowcharts and guides to help you with many parts of the pack accessable via the server's helpful bot, development announcements and more are available in the &n#announcements&r channel, and the community helps with tech support questions, and investigates possible bug reports.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.rich_descrip: To join the server, you can use the button on the Main Menu to go to the join URL, or if you're not into Discord you can find other projects from Pansmith, one of the modpack authors, on
moni.quest.71C7B47DC85AA016.description1: &9Phenol&r is produced as a byproduct from making &6Coal Coke&r in a &3Pyrolyse Oven&r.
moni.quest.75810A27FBBBFB77.description3: Naquadah Chemistry yields large amounts of a variety of valuable resources. It will serve as your primary source of radioactive elements such as &6Neptunium&r, &6Curium&r, and &6Berkelium&r, as well as providing quite a bit of other advanced materials such as &6Tritanium&r, &6Darmstadtium&r, and &6Neutronium&r.
moni.quest.7A67E519745A8361.description1: Once you have obtained your first piece of &6Hellish Matter&r, or unlocked the &3Atomic Reconstructor&r, travel to the &eNether&r becomes available.
moni.quest.7A67E519745A8361.description8: Despite all this, &eNether&r travel is still strictly optional in the pack, although it is recommended.
